_comment: Ed25519 public keys allowed to SIGN evidence manifests. FAIL-CLOSED: if a manifest's signer is not listed here, its attestation is REJECTED. Generate a key with tools/keygen.py, then paste the printed public key below as "<signer-name>": "<base64-public-key>". Keep private keys OFF this repo. Assessors/witnesses who sign their own statements get their own entry.
